def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bgv=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    s=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] in (2,3)]
    rs=sorted({r for r,_ in s}); a,e_=rs[0],rs[-1]
    lo2=min(c for r,c in s if g[r][c]==2); hi2=max(c for r,c in s if g[r][c]==2)
    lo3=min(c for r,c in s if g[r][c]==3); hi3=max(c for r,c in s if g[r][c]==3)
    cand=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==bgv for r in range(a+1,e_))]
    n=max(sum(g[r][c]==bgv for r in range(a+1,e_)) for c in cand)
    cs=[c for c in cand if sum(g[r][c]==bgv for r in range(a+1,e_))==n]
    def top(c): return sum(1 for x in range(lo2,c) if g[a][x]==bgv)
    def bot(c): return sum(1 for x in range(c,hi3) if g[e_][x]==bgv)
    sel=max(cs,key=lambda c:(min(top(c),bot(c)), -c))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(a,e_+1):
        if g[r][sel]!=2 and g[r][sel]!=3: out[r][sel]=3
    for r in (a,e_):
        rng=(min(lo2,lo3),max(hi2,hi3))
        for x in range(*rng):
            if g[r][x]==bgv: out[r][x]=3
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bgv=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    s=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] in (2,3)]
    rs=sorted({r for r,_ in s}); a,e_=rs[0],rs[-1]
    lo2=min(c for r,c in s if g[r][c]==2); hi2=max(c for r,c in s if g[r][c]==2)
    lo3=min(c for r,c in s if g[r][c]==3); hi3=max(c for r,c in s if g[r][c]==3)
    cand=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==bgv for r in range(a+1,e_))]
    n=max(sum(g[r][c]==bgv for r in range(a+1,e_)) for c in cand)
    cs=[c for c in cand if sum(g[r][c]==bgv for r in range(a+1,e_))==n]
    mid=(lo2+hi2+lo3+hi3)/4
    sel=min(cs,key=lambda c:(abs(c-mid)))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(a,e_+1):
        if g[r][sel]!=2 and g[r][sel]!=3: out[r][sel]=3
    def paint(r,c):
        # fill bg cells on band row between corridor and seed block, toward nearest seed
        if c<lo2: l,rh=lo2+1,c
        elif c>hi2: l,rh=c,lo2
        else: return
        for x in range(l,min(rh,c)):
            if g[r][x]==bgv: out[r][x]=3
        if c<lo3: l,rh=lo3+1,c
        elif c>hi3: l,rh=c,hi3
        else: return
        for x in range(l,max(rh,c)):
            if g[r][x]==bgv: out[r][x]=3
    paint(a,sel); paint(e_,sel)
    return out

    Q=deque(S)
    while Q:
        a,b=Q.popleft()
        if (a,b) in T: break
        for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

    # reconstruct: pick target with shortest pred chain
    best=None

        while cur not in S and cur is not None:

        if best is None or len(chain)<len(best[0]): best=(chain,chain[-1])

    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for p,q in [(p,p) for p in [] ] : pass
    for p in best[0]: out[p[0]][p[1]]=res[0][0]

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
inp=G['Test input']
H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
# find seed objects (non-bg pairs)
vals=[v for r in inp for v in r]; cnt={v:vals.count(v) for v in set(vals)}
bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
from collections import deque
seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; objs=[]
for i in range(H):
    for j in range(W):
        v=inp[i][j]
        if v==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
        q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; comp=[(i,j)]
        while q:
            a,b=q.popleft()
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and inp[x][y]==v:
                    seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y)); comp.append((x,y))
        objs.append((v,tuple(sorted(comp))))
objs.sort(key=lambda c:len(c[1]))
src,obj=objs[0],objs[1]
print(src,obj)
def walk(g,start,target_col,end_row_color=None):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    b=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def isob(i,j): return g[i][j]!=b and g[i][j]!=target_col
    i,j=start
    dirs=[(0,1),(1,0),(0,-1),(-1,0)]
    moved=True
    while True:
        nxt=[(i+dx,j+dy) for dx,dy in dirs if 0<=i+dx<H and 0<=j+dy<W and not isob(i+dx,j+dy)]
        # try moves matching preferred order; allow only one new direction change per step group
        added=False
        for dx,dy in dirs:
            x,y=i+dx,j+dy
            if not (0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or isob(x,y): continue
            # keep current direction if can continue straight
            if dy==dx==0: continue
            if g[x][y]==target_col:
                for xx in [i,j]: pass
                break
            # greedily pick direction: first direction that allows continuing straight next step too
            cand=[dd for dd in dirs if 0<=i+dd[0]<H and 0<=j+dd[1]<W and not isob(i+dd[0],j+dd[1])]
            if dx*dy>0 and False: pass
            # simpler: prefer direction with max continuation distance
            breaks={}
            for dd in [(dx,dy)]:
                n=0
                cur=i+dx,j+dy
                while 0<=cur[0]<H and 0<=cur[1]<W and not isob(*cur):
                    n+=1; cur=(cur[0]+dd[0],cur[1]+dd[1])
                breaks[dd]=n
            if len(nxt)>1:
                dd=max(breaks,key=breaks.get)
                # but don't switch direction mid-run: only move straight within current dir unless forced
                if dx==dd[0] and dy==dd[1]:
                    i,j=i+dx,j+dy; added=True; continue
            i,j=nxt[0]
            if g[i][j]==target_col: break
            if added and i==start[0] and j==start[1]: break
        else:
            i,j=nxt[0] if nxt else None; break
    return (i,j)

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[v for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=bg]
    # two colors: find their cells
    objs={}
    for v in colors:
        objs[v]=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==v]
    assert all(len(o)==2 for o in objs.values())
    def clear(i,j,a,b):  # true iff all cells between exclusive endpoints along direction a-b are free (not obstacle, may pass other obj colors)
        return True if b-a else False
    def horz_clear(r1,c1,r2,c2):
        step=(0,1) if c2>c1 else (0,-1)
        x,y=c1+step[0],c1+step[1]
        while x<c2 or y>c2 or (x<y==False and abs(x-c1)==0): 
            pass
        return all(inp[x][y]!=bg for xx in range(c1+step[0] if False else min(c1,c2)+step[0]*0, c2+step[1]) for x,y in [(xx+c1-step[1]*0 if False else xx, c2)] ) if False else None
    return None

def ncomps_of(inp,bg):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]);C=[];seen=set()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if inp[i][j]==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(i,j)]);seen.add((i,j));comp=[(i,j)];c=inp[i][j]
            while q:
                x,y=q.popleft()
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    xx,yy=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=xx<H and 0<=yy<W and (xx,yy) not in seen and inp[xx][yy]!=bg:
                        seen.add((xx,yy));q.append((xx,yy));comp.append((xx,yy))
            C.append(comp)
    return C

def orient(cells): return 'h' if len({i for i,j in cells})==1 else 'v'

    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])

    pairs=[v for v in shapes.values() if len(v)==2]

    A,B=pairs[0]

    ar=min(i for i,j in top); br=min(i for i,j in bot)
    ea=max(j for i,j in top); eb=max(j for i,j in bot)

G=load()
def corner_rule(n):
    inp=G[n+' input']; exp=G[n+' output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sp=[c for c,k in cnt.items() if k==2 and c!=bgv]
    A=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==sp[0]]
    B=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==sp[1]]
    ar=min(i for i,j in A); br=min(i for i,j in B)
    ea=max(j for i,j in A); eb=max(j for i,j in B)
    lo,hi=min(ea,eb),max(ea,eb)
    p={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if exp[i][j]==3 and inp[i][j]!=3}
    bend=[sorted({j for i,j in p if i not in (ar,br)})[0] if any(i not in(ar,br) for i,j in p) else None]
    # vertical segment column: the column of cells whose painted set includes rows between ar&br
    vertcol={j for i,j in p if min(ar,br)<i<max(ar,br)}
    print(n,'exp corner',bend[0],'vert col',sorted(vertcol),'| top run from ea to corner clear? bottom from corner to eb clear?')
corner_rule('Demo pair 6');corner_rule('Demo pair 7');corner_rule('Demo pair 8')

G=load()
def analyze(n):
    inp=G[n+' input']; H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sp=[c for c,k in cnt.items() if k==2 and c!=bgv]
    A=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==sp[0]]
    B=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==sp[1]]
    ar=min(i for i,j in A); br=min(i for i,j in B)
    ea=max(j for i,j in A); eb=max(j for i,j in B)
    p={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=exp[i][j]} | {(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if exp[i][j]==3 and inp[i][j]!=3}
    bend={sorted({j for i,j in p if min(ar,br)<i<max(ar,br)})[0]}
    res=[]
    for cc in range(min(ea,eb),max(ea,eb)+1):
        tl=sum(1 for j in range(ea+1,cc+1) if inp[ar][j]==bgv)
        tb=sum(1 for j in range(cc+1,eb+1) if inp[br][j]==bgv)
        vb=sum(1 for i in range(ar+1,br) if inp[i][cc]==bgv)
        s=tl+tb+vb
        ok=('ALL CLEAR' if (tl>0 or tb>0) and all((inp[ar][j]==bgv or j in(A,B) or (ar,ea)==(ar,j)) for j in range(min(ea,eb),cc+1))) else ''
        tag='  <<EXP' if cc in bend else ''
        res.append((cc,tl,tb,vb,s,tag))
    print(n,'bend',sorted(bend)[:1])
    for x in sorted(res,key=lambda t:(t[4],-t[0]))[:8]: print(x)
for n in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    analyze(n)

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[c for c in comps_of(inp,None) if len(c)==2 and inp[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]!=bgv]
    (a1,a2),(b1,b2)=objs
    sp={inp[x[0]][x[1]] for x in a1+a2+b1+b2}
    start=set(a1); target=set(b1)  # or use both endpoints as targets; pick one endpoint pair per object
    INF=10**9
    dist={}
    q=deque([(dist[i]:=INF,i) for i in []]) if False else deque()
    pq=[]
    for s in list(start):
        dist[s]=0; heapq.heappush(pq,(0,s))
    pred={s:None for s in start}
    while pq:
        d,u=heapq.heappop(pq)
        if u in target: break
        x,y=u
        for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            v=(x+dx,y+dy)

            dist[v]=d+1; pred[v]=u; heapq.heappush(pq,(d+1,v))
    # reconstruct
    path=[]; u=list(target)[0]
    while u not in start:
        path.append(u); u=pred[u]
    path.extend(start)
    path.sort(); return [(i,j) for i,j in path]

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    A=comps_of(2,inp)[0];B=comps_of(3,inp)[0]
    dist={s:0 for s in A};parent={s:None for s in A}
    Tset=set(B)
    hit=None
    q=deque(A)
    while q:
        p=q.popleft()
        x,y=p
        if inp[x][y]==3: hit=(x,y);break
        for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b=x+dx,y+dy
            if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and (a,b) not in dist:
                if inp[a][b]==3: hit=(a,b);break
                dist[(a,b)]=dist[p]+1;parent[(a,b)]=p;q.append((a,b))
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    Sset=set(map(tuple,A))
    cur=hit
    while cur:
        if cur in Tset or cur in Sset: break
        out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
        parent.get(cur,None)
        cur = parent.get(cur)
    return out
for n in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    O=solve(G[n+' input']); E=G[n+' output']
    di={(i,j) for i in range(len(O)) for j in range(len(O[0])) if O[i][j]!=G[n+' input'][i][j]}
    de={(i,j) for i in range(len(E)) for j in range(len(E[0])) if E[i][j]!=G[n+' input'][i][j]}
    print(n,'match:',di==de,len(di^de))

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comps_of(val):
        seen=set();res=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if inp[i][j]==val and (i,j) not in seen:
                    st=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j));cc=[]
                    while st:
                        xx,yy=st.pop();cc.append((xx,yy))
                        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            a,b=xx+dr,yy+dc
                            if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and inp[a][b]==val and (a,b) not in seen:
                                seen.add((a,b));st.append((a,b))
                    res.append(cc)
        return res
    A=comps_of(2)[0];B=comps_of(3)[0]
    Sset=set(map(tuple,A));Tset=set(map(tuple,B))
    # corner orientation: single-cell-thick bar; direction = from one end to the other
    cands=sorted(B)
    d=(cands[-1][0]-cands[0][0], cands[-1][1]-cands[0][1])
    # choose end of corner nearer to object, extend beyond it, then march toward object via greedy shortest-path BFS
    import heapq as h
    # BFS multi-source from all corner cells, restricted to bg cells, 4-dir
    dist={}
    Q=h.QueuedMaxHeap()  # placeholder
    q=h.PriorityQueue()
    for s in B: q.put((-0,s[0],s[1]));dist[s]=0
    best=None
    while True:
        negd,x,y=q.get()
        d= -negd
        if d>best[0] if best else False: break

import heapq
def solve(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    A=comps_of(2,inp);B=comps_of(3,inp)
    Sset=set(map(tuple,A));Tset=set(map(tuple,B))
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    # Dijkstra from all bar cells over non-bg, non-bar cells; pred stores last dir
    q=[];pred={};cost={}
    for s in Tset:
        heappush(q,(0,s[0],s[1]));pred[(s[0],s[1])]=None;cost[(s[0],s[1])]=0
    dirs=[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]
    while q:
        _,x,y=heappop(q)
        if (x,y) in Sset: break
        for dx,dy in dirs:
            nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
            if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and (nx,ny) not in pred and inp[nx][ny]!=bgv and (nx,ny) not in Tset:
                ncost=cost[(x,y)]+1
                if (nx,ny) not in cost or ncost<cost[(nx,ny)]:
                    cost[(nx,ny)]=ncost;pred[(nx,ny)]=(dx,dy)
                    heappush(q,(ncost,nx,ny))
    tgt=min(Sset,key=lambda s:(abs(s[0]-min(c[0] for c in B))**2+abs(s[1]-min(c[1] for c in B))**2))
    cur=tgt
    while True:
        p=pred.get(cur)
        if p is None or p in Sset or p in Tset or inp[cur[0]][cur[1]]==bgv: break
        cur=p
    chain=[]
    x,y=cur
    while cur not in Sset:
        chain.append((x,y));cur=pred[cur]
    x,y=chain[-1]
    dirc=None
    while True:
        if abs(x-min(c[0] for c in B))==1 or abs(y-min(c[1] for c in B))==1: break
        moved=False
        for dx,dy in dirs:
            nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
            if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and (nx,ny) not in Tset and (nx,ny) not in Sset and (nx,ny) not in chain:
                if abs(nx-min(c[0] for c in B))+abs(ny-min(c[1] for c in B))<abs(x-min(c[0] for c in B))+abs(y-min(c[1] for c in B)):
                    out[nx][ny]=3;x,y=nx,ny;moved=True;break
        if not moved: break
    return out
